title: finding(fields,plugin-view,plugin-form,plugin-list): five consumer casts erase `SchemaRendererContextType`, so reading a member the context does not have compiles clean
body:
## What was measured (on `9c7490268`, while correcting the comments for objectui#7206)

Two consumer modules re-declare the imported `SchemaRendererContext` with its type argument erased to `any`, and three more cast at the use site:

```
git grep -n 'React.Context' -- packages/fields packages/plugin-view packages/plugin-form packages/plugin-list
packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx:60   const SchemaRendererContext: React.Context<any> = ImportedSchemaRendererContext;
packages/plugin-view/src/index.tsx:55            const SchemaRendererContext: React.Context<any> = ImportedSchemaRendererContext;
packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx:245           useContext(SchemaRendererContext as React.Context<any>)
packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx:306           useContext(SchemaRendererContext as React.Context<any>)
packages/plugin-list/src/ListViewBlock.tsx:102   useContext(SchemaRendererContext as React.Context<any>)
```

`useCascadingOptions.ts:36` does the same inline: `useContext(SchemaRendererContext) as any`.

## Why this is worth recording

`SchemaRendererContextType` declares exactly `dataSource` / `debug` / `debugFlags` / `apiFetch`. Every one of these casts erases that, so a read of a member the context does **not** have compiles clean.

That is the mechanism behind objectui#7206: `ctx?.formValues ?? ctx?.data` type-checks in both readers, was documented as a working channel in thirteen comments across ten files, and misled two implementations — objectui#7165 and objectui#7190 — into reasoning about a fallback that has never existed. **With the real context type in place, `ctx.formValues` would have been a compile error on the day it was written.**

Control, so the census above is a reading and not an empty grep: over the same paths the same query shape returns 13 lines for `useContext(` and 5 for `React.Context` — the instrument is live, and the 5 are exactly the lines listed above.

This repo has already ruled on the same shape once, from the other end: objectui#4422 (`forwardRef` plus a props index signature silently erases every declared prop type, 11 renderers). This is that defect in a context rather than a props object.

## Not proposing the fix here

Removing the casts is not mechanical — `LookupField` and `plugin-view` cast because they read members across a package boundary where the exported type may be structurally awkward, and tightening it could surface other reads that are also unsettable. That triage is the work, and it interacts with whichever way objectui#7206's A/B/C question is settled: if a `data` member is added, some of these reads become legitimate. Filed for triage, not queued.

## Not filed as a duplicate

Searched before filing; two targeted queries, both returning non-empty result sets. objectui#7206 is about the dead tail and its comments, not about the cast that hides it. objectui#4422 is the props-object twin and is closed.
